content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe operates in only 46 of the 195 countries worldwide, which severely limits access for many digital creators. PayPal's restrictive policies can lead to account suspensions, during which funds may be held for up to 180 days without recourse. Gumroad and similar platforms also impose geographic restrictions, making it impossible for creators in certain regions to monetize their work. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to set up their own stores using free tools and automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring that they maintain complete control over their businesses.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's geographic limitations effectively exclude creators from countries with unstable currencies or high-risk designations. This exclusion not only hinders sales but also stifles innovation among digital creators. Alternatives like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow similar patterns, shutting out significant markets. COREMERCH's approach stands in stark contrast; by leveraging decentralized tools and direct crypto payment processing, creators can operate unrestricted by geographic boundaries, allowing them to sell their digital products globally without being locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processors like PayPal and Stripe typically charge significant fees, often around 2.9% plus a fixed fee per transaction, which can add up quickly. Delays in payment processing can lead to cash flow issues for creators relying on these platforms. In contrast, COREMERCH's model utilizes NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee and provides immediate on-chain payment verification, ensuring faster access to funds. This low-cost, rapid payment processing allows creators to focus on their craft rather than worrying about when they will receive their earnings.
COREMERCH empowers creators with full ownership of their digital sales infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Traditional platforms such as Gumroad and Stripe require creators to adhere to their terms and conditions, leading to a lack of ownership over the sales process and the risk of account suspensions. When creators rely on these services, they don't truly own their customer data or product delivery methods. COREMERCH empowers creators with full ownership of their setups, meaning they control their data, products, and customer interactions. The automation provided by NOWPayments and other integrated tools enables seamless delivery of digital products immediately upon payment confirmation, enhancing the customer experience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators facing restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal, choosing the right architecture is crucial. If rapid deployment and low cost are priorities, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a quick solution. For those needing more features and robustness, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal, providing a complete suite of tools for a fully operational online store. Each stack is designed to ensure that creators can scale their businesses without facing the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Say goodbye to payment processor restrictions; choose your own path with COREMERCH.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
